steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Switch the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet and terms controls are available.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product's configured Variant 1 should populate automatically.
Set the requested delivery location in the first product row.

args.goal: On the buyer create screen, open Terms & Conditions, open Edit event specific T&Cs, change one clause, press Done, then start a new event in a fresh create flow and verify that its default terms still show the original unchanged clause rather than the edited event-specific clause

steps.note: Perform the terms-specific edit and compare it with a newly created event, which no dedicated catalog step can operate directly.
Confirm the create flow still exposes the Terms & Conditions control after the isolation check.
